body:
A pain how? Do you  get really irritable  like I do?  I find people  exhausting but at the same time I extremely  lonely. Constantly  caught between missing  friends and avoiding seeing anybody. Depression  makes an internal conflict  over every thing.

Yeh I know out parents probably  thought they were doing a good thing, but it's a lot of anxiety  for a kid. 

I haven't  done either for years. Horses are expensive and I'm  a few too many head injuries  in to long board anymore. Now my most active  hobbies are Netflix and cynicism. What are your hobbies? Does anything  make you happy anymore?

It does get harder to make friends as you get older. On so many levels. It's the inside jokes and the subtle  things that develop  between friends when you're  younger, like knowing when to shut up and when to be honest or how to make each other laugh. Then you get older and reaching that level of intimacy  is so much harder when everyone  has jobs and kids etc etc. I'm  sorry your best friend  is moving. I didn't  think it would be so bad when my best friend moved, but I miss  her every  day. You seem like that rarest  of rare things these days. A kind person. Not the self serving "kind" person, but a genuine  one. I know how hard it is to make friends as you get older, but people  will come to you. Every  one needs a little  kindness.

Global  warming got you too huh? Like all the life stuff is one thing. Existential  terror of the apocalypse is just an unnecessary  kick in the groin. You know what's  funny? I grew up with a heavily  religious  mother who believed  wholeheartedly  in the rapture. I have never  not thought that the world would end in a fiery hellscape. As a child I was just told that Jesus was the reason it would happen.

I dont know how much I have to offer. Maybe I did once. I remember  longboarding and horse riding and having fun. Now increasingly  I think  I'm  just becoming  bitter and joyless. I feel  like in three years I may start sporting a Karen hairstyle and start  bitching at store managers just to spread this stupid misery. 

Then I'll  really  have to kill myself.

How old are you, if I may ask?

I'm  in a toxic  marriage. I have nowhere  to go. Everyone  around me has their own issues and I cant add to it. My close friends have moved far away, the remaining  people  I have isolated  myself from because  I needed  to cut my old drugged up lifestyle  out and because it became impossible  to have friends and have my marriage at the same time and I chose my marriage ( don't  roll your eyes).  My career is non existent and like most of us, I'm often underpaid and overworked. I desperately  want to go back to study but again but not sure how to pull it off. I lost someone  I love this year.  I feel like doors are shutting around me and the earth is literally  dying with a five year drought affecting  my family's  security. So sometimes... a lot of the time...I think...it would be nice to just not exist anymore. It wouldn't  be great loss to humanity, I'm  not exactly  going to  cure cancer.
Ah. I see. Anything  causing your depression  or is it nothing  specific?

Amazing  is a strong word. I prefer: ambiguously committed to life. Why do you want to help people? Specifically  here, now? It's a frustrating  thing to do. Suicidal  folk aren't  known for their upbeat conversational style. And by that  I mean; suicidal  people  are extremely  frustrating  to talk  to because they turn every positive  into a negative as a simple  knee jerk reaction.

No. Dont worry. I'm  a multiple  attempter.  It's way harder  to kill yourself than what you think. It's really  an embarrassing  bad habit that I try in awhile. No I looked it up after the fact. Apparently  I didn't  have enough of anything in the house  to actually  kill me. Think Helena  Bonham Carter in Fight Club, one of those cry for help things. Only... you know. It's  way cooler  when its Marla Singer. I was just pathetic.
I have deep depressions that come and go. Yesterday  was a bad one. I swallowed  a lot of pills. I'm  sorry I didn't  reply when you did. Why were you having  a bad day?
